name: AWS CIS Foundations Guard
description: Named compliance bundle mapped to the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0 (IAM, Storage, Logging, Monitoring, Networking sections) plus a few AWS Foundational Security Best Practices controls. Every rule name carries its control ID so the installed group doubles as the coverage evidence for audits and security questionnaires. Control-removing operations need admin approval; control-weakening ones need a written reason; hygiene gaps draw a warning.

rules.name: [CIS 1.10] Require access request to deactivate or delete an MFA device
rules.description: CIS AWS Foundations 1.10: MFA must be enabled for all IAM users with a console password. Deactivating or deleting an MFA device removes it. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: [CIS 1.8/1.9] Require access request to delete the account password policy
rules.description: CIS 1.8 (minimum length 14) and 1.9 (password reuse prevention) depend on the account password policy existing. Deleting it reverts to AWS defaults. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: [CIS 1.8/1.9] Require justification to weaken the account password policy
rules.description: Setting --minimum-password-length below 14 or --password-reuse-prevention below 24 fails CIS 1.8 / 1.9. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: [CIS 1.16] Require access request to attach full administrative privileges
rules.description: CIS 1.16: no IAM policy should allow full "*:*" administrative privileges. Attaching AdministratorAccess or writing an Action "*" policy document fails it. Requires admin approval. The AWS IAM Least-Privilege Guard pack covers this in more depth.

rules.name: [CIS 1.20] Require access request to delete an IAM Access Analyzer
rules.description: CIS 1.20: IAM Access Analyzer must be enabled in all active regions. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: [CIS 1.15] Require justification to attach policies directly to IAM users
rules.description: CIS 1.15: permissions are granted only through groups or roles. attach-user-policy / put-user-policy fail it. Requires a written reason. Instead: attach to a group or role.

rules.name: [CIS 1.11/1.14] Require justification to create long-lived IAM access keys
rules.description: CIS 1.11 discourages access keys at user setup and 1.14 requires 90-day rotation. Creating a new key adds a long-lived credential. Requires a written reason. Instead: IAM roles or IAM Identity Center short-lived credentials.

rules.name: [CIS 2.1.4] Require access request to remove S3 public access blocks or set public ACLs
rules.description: CIS 2.1.4: S3 Block Public Access must be enabled at the account and bucket level. Deleting the block, setting any block flag to false, or applying a public ACL (public-read, public-read-write, AllUsers, AuthenticatedUsers) exposes data. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: [CIS 2.2.1] Require access request to disable EBS encryption by default
rules.description: CIS 2.2.1: EBS volume encryption must be enabled by default. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: [CIS 2.3.3] Require access request to make an RDS instance publicly accessible
rules.description: CIS 2.3.3: RDS instances must not be publicly accessible. --publicly-accessible on create or modify fails it. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: [CIS 2.1.2] Require justification to suspend versioning or MFA delete on S3
rules.description: CIS 2.1.2: MFA Delete should be enabled on S3 versioned buckets. Suspending versioning or disabling MFADelete weakens recoverability. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: [CIS 2.1.1] Require justification to delete an S3 bucket policy
rules.description: CIS 2.1.1: buckets must deny HTTP requests via a bucket policy. Deleting the bucket policy removes that deny. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: [CIS 2.3.1] Require justification to create an unencrypted RDS instance
rules.description: CIS 2.3.1: RDS encryption at rest must be enabled. create-db-instance without --storage-encrypted fails it. Requires a written reason. Instead: add --storage-encrypted (and --kms-key-id).

rules.name: [CIS 2.4.1] Require justification to create an unencrypted EFS file system
rules.description: CIS 2.4.1: EFS must be encrypted at rest. create-file-system without --encrypted fails it. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: [CIS 2.3.2] Warn when RDS auto minor version upgrade is disabled
rules.description: CIS 2.3.2: auto minor version upgrades keep the engine patched. Records a warning.

rules.name: [CIS 3.1] Require access request to stop, delete or narrow a CloudTrail trail
rules.description: CIS 3.1: CloudTrail must be enabled in all regions with global service events. stop-logging, delete-trail, --no-is-multi-region-trail and --no-include-global-service-events fail it. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: [CIS 3.3] Require access request to stop or delete the AWS Config recorder
rules.description: CIS 3.3: AWS Config must be enabled in all regions. Deleting or stopping the configuration recorder or its delivery channel fails it. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: [CIS 3.2] Require justification to disable CloudTrail log file validation
rules.description: CIS 3.2: log file validation proves the trail was not tampered with. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: [CIS 3.4] Require justification to turn off S3 server access logging
rules.description: CIS 3.4: the CloudTrail bucket (and sensitive buckets) must have access logging. An empty --bucket-logging-status turns it off. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: [CIS 3.6] Require justification to disable KMS key rotation or a KMS key
rules.description: CIS 3.6: customer-managed KMS keys must rotate. disable-key-rotation fails it; disable-key makes data unreadable. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: [CIS 3.7] Require justification to delete VPC flow logs
rules.description: CIS 3.7: VPC flow logging must be enabled in all VPCs. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: [CIS 4.x] Require justification to delete metric filters, alarms or their SNS topics
rules.description: CIS 4.1–4.16 require CloudWatch metric filters and alarms for unauthorised API calls, console sign-in without MFA, root usage, IAM changes, CloudTrail/Config changes, and more. Deleting a filter, alarm, or the SNS topic/subscription that delivers it breaks the control. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: [CIS 5.2/5.3] Require access request to open SSH, RDP or all traffic to the internet
rules.description: CIS 5.2 / 5.3: no security group may allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to port 22, 3389, or all ports/protocols. Requires admin approval. Instead: restrict to the VPN/bastion CIDR or use SSM Session Manager.

rules.name: [CIS 5.2/5.3] Require justification for any security group ingress from the internet
rules.description: Ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 on any port widens the attack surface. Requires a written reason naming the service that must be public.

rules.name: [CIS 5.1] Require justification for NACL entries allowing admin ports from the internet
rules.description: CIS 5.1: no network ACL may allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22 or 3389. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: [CIS 5.4] Require justification to add rules to the default security group
rules.description: CIS 5.4: the default security group of every VPC must restrict all traffic. Adding rules to it fails the control. Requires a written reason. Instead: create a purpose-named security group.

rules.name: [CIS 5.6] Require justification to allow IMDSv1 on an instance
rules.description: CIS 5.6: EC2 metadata service must require IMDSv2 (HttpTokens=required). --http-tokens optional re-enables IMDSv1 credential theft paths. Requires a written reason.

rules.name: [CIS 5.6] Warn when instances launch without IMDSv2 enforced
rules.description: run-instances without --metadata-options HttpTokens=required leaves IMDSv1 enabled on the new instance. Records a warning. Instead: add --metadata-options HttpTokens=required,HttpEndpoint=enabled.

rules.name: [CIS 5.5] Warn on VPC peering connections
rules.description: CIS 5.5: routing tables for VPC peering must be least access. Creating or accepting a peering connection is the moment to check the routes. Records a warning.

rules.name: [FSBP GuardDuty.1 / SecurityHub.1 / Macie.1] Require access request to disable threat detection services
rules.description: AWS Foundational Security Best Practices require GuardDuty, Security Hub, Macie and Inspector to stay enabled. Deleting a detector, disabling Security Hub, or disabling Macie/Inspector removes detection. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: [FSBP EC2.1 / RDS.1] Require access request to share AMIs or snapshots publicly
rules.description: Making an AMI, EBS snapshot or RDS snapshot public (Group=all / --values-to-add all) exposes its contents to every AWS account. Requires admin approval.

rules.name: [FSBP SNS.1 / SQS.1 / ECR.1 / Lambda.1] Require access request for resource policies open to any principal
rules.description: A resource policy (SNS topic, SQS queue, ECR repository, Secrets Manager, KMS, Lambda permission) with "Principal": "*" makes the resource callable from any account. Requires admin approval. Instead: name the account or role ARN.
